title: Attribution
scene: In a school hallway a student watches a classmate hurry past without noticing them. Above the observer is a single thought bubble containing a small image of the hurried classmate with a frowning face, representing the observer's guess about the reason. Make clear the thought-bubble image is imagined: the actual walking classmate has a neutral expression and carries schoolbooks. Only two actual people, natural arms, no pointing.
alt: A student watches a neutral classmate hurry past and imagines that classmate frowning in a thought bubble, guessing why they did not stop.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square glossary illustration for a middle-school Crew SEL pack. Style: warm simple flat illustration with muted earth colors, clean uncluttered shapes, softly textured paper and respectful expressions. Fictional diverse students ages 12 to 14. No words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos or watermarks. Every person must have exactly two naturally attached arms and coherent hair.
